notes.title: Cap Log #1: Character and Crew Customization
notes.notes:
Avast Ye Scallywags! Today we want to show you our character customization screen and how it works. We hope that you will be able to create some Cool looking Corsairs or Beefy Buccaneers with it.

[i][b]Video of changing crewmates outfit, body, and color scheme[/b][/i]
[previewyoutube=SiPUg9KJj9M;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][i]Picture of Uniform Customization Menu[/i][/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084477/7519b0ac3dcbc63299c5c59b93f8bcd84282cf69.jpg[/img]
As you can see in the middle of the screen we have a large option of clothing to choose from. Combined with the color customization options, their are MILLIONS of unique uniform combinations you can create for your pirates. Also keep in mind we plan to add female pirates, as well as European and African phenotypes and hairstyles. Even after we publish our game, we will continue to update and add more character models.

[i][b]Example of Clothing Color Customization:[/b][/i] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42084477/3d314a13851bb78f6fcfc724b48972ca187a849d.jpg[/img]
These four pirates are all wearing the same Torso Model, a Similar Leg Model, and Bandana on their head. The main difference is the Color Scheme of each of their uniforms. Using "Color Masks" we have implemented the ability for you to manually choose the Color of each piece of clothing on each of your Pirates. You can change the color of your Boots, Sashe, Shirt, Bandana, Socks, Trousers, Vests and much more. The Color Information is saved in a database and will work in multiplayer. Meaning if you wanted to create a crew of pirates that wears all green and yellow and name them "Turtles of Tortuga" you can do it. Or you can make each of your pirates a different color like the Power Rangers. Or if you are feeling a bit Sad, you can make all your pirates wear Dastardly Dark Black robes.

For those of you who can't wait to try and play our game, we have some great news! We have decided to participate in the Steam Festival this coming June. Meaning that for 1 week during the month of June we will release a DEMO copy of our game onto the steam store and you will be able to play it for  
F. R. E. E. More news on that coming next week in our weekly Captains Log posted every Sunday. Be their or be square.

notes.title: AHOY THEIR LADS!
notes.notes:
Ahoy their lads! This be our first dev blog and we are excited and honored that you are interested in joining our Pirate crew! Our team has been hard at work day and night for the past year and a half  on this project and we have so many cool features and amazing mechanics to showcase for your viewing pleasure. We plan on publishing a new developer blog , or as we will from this point onward call it our "Captains Log", every single week on Sunday. Over the next month we plan on showcasing our Character customization system, Our melee combat system, our day/night and Weather Cycles, and looting/loot generation system.

We are currently working on a trailer for Plunder Struck which will be released soon. However, we do have a video you can view right now on our Fiera Gold Studio Youtube channel, which showcases many of the features in great detail that we want you to see (It's linked below). Check it out, we promise you won't be disappointed. Also to erase any confusion. This video is showcasing assets from another project Studio Fieria Gold is working on called Wind Rose. However, the features demonstrated in this video are also utilized in Plunder Struck. Feel free to check out the other cool videos on this channel as well. We are also working on creating a YoutTube channel dedicated to only Plunder Struck content and it will be active in the near future.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1jTyLBk7FlU&ab_channel=FieriaGold

Plunder Struck is a pirate themed Hardcore Multiplayer RPG where you control a small group of 1-7 pirates. You can trade and barter with NPC's and go on Quests and do allot of RPG stuff that you can't do in Wind Rose. However Wind Rose also has some cool stuff you can't do in Plunder Struck. However, if you love one game we think you will love the other.

Wind Rose is set in the same era, but it is about conflicts between the Napoleonic factions of Europe. It also features really cool fantasy steampunk machinery such as "Da Vinci" themed tanks, semi automatic muskets, bolt action electric rifles and much more. You also control a large army instead of a small squad. It is focused on grand scale battles, but it also has a great linear story driven campaign.

For more information on both projects you can visit our company website. It's currently in Russian, but if your on Google you can right click your screen when you are viewing the page and click translate to English or whatever language may be.

https://fieriagold.net/
